name: Effigy: Credit brokerage platform
description: Public marketing site and credit simulators for a Portuguese credit intermediary: React SPA, TypeScript API with live updates, and a hardened admin CMS backed by official rate sources.
longDescription: Full-stack delivery for a credit brokerage brand: a React single-page app for product pages, simulators, team and partner content, plus contact and simulation flows with server-side validation. A modern TypeScript API powers live content sync; a classic PHP hosting path remains for shared hosting when needed. An admin CMS manages rates from official sources (ECB, Banco de Portugal, Tax Authority), team profiles, and brand assets. Deployments use container builds and traditional hosting with automated quality checks in the release pipeline.
features: Config-driven credit simulators fed by live official rate data
Unified API for public site and admin CMS
Real-time content sync between admin edits and the public site
Responsive marketing layouts and accessible navigation
Secure admin authentication, CSRF protection, and rate limiting
Automated lint, type-check, and test stages before release
highlights: Single product surface for simulators, CMS, and public marketing
Reliable simulator UX with validated submissions and resilient API behaviour
Production-ready security and deployment split across modern and classic hosting
challenges: Financial sites must keep simulators accurate while protecting admin data on shared infrastructure.
solutions: Layered API security, editable rates without redeploys, typed contracts between frontend and backend, and automated checks before each release.
security: Authenticated admin area with session hardening and CSRF on mutations
Secrets and signing keys only from secure environment configuration
Submission data stored outside direct public web access
HTTPS and upload validation enforced in production
